name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-cleanup
description: Keeps account of what AI agents leave behind on a Mac and removes only what is proven theirs.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_DATA_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Where the ledger, the learned rules and the logs of runs and sweeps live; one directory for every session on the machine.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_HOOK_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: The directory, private to its user, of the socket hooks hand their events to a running server through; a socket path may be 104 bytes at most.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_TRASH_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Where what cannot be made again is moved to instead of being erased.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_SCRATCH_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Where Claude Code makes its claude-<uid> scratch root.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_SLEEP_OF_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Where Snail.SleepOf keeps its agents.json, the first place sessions are read from.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_ANDROID_SDK
environmentVariables.description: The Android SDK with emulator, platform-tools and system-images.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_AVD_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Where Android virtual devices are defined.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_EDITOR_USER_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: VS Code's user directory, with workspaceStorage inside.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_CLAUDE_SETTINGS
environmentVariables.description: Claude Code's settings, where install-hooks writes this server's hooks.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_SCRATCHPAD_WARNING_GIGABYTES
environmentVariables.description: How large a running session's scratchpad may grow, in gigabytes, before the inventory and every plan warn of it.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_DISK_FALL_WARNING_GIGABYTES
environmentVariables.description: How far the free space may fall within a day, in gigabytes, before the inventory warns and names what grew most.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_SWEEP_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: How often, in minutes, the server clears on its own what may go without asking; 0 turns it off.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_DOCKER_CACHE_SWEEP_GIGABYTES
environmentVariables.description: How large Docker's build cache may grow, in gigabytes, before the server's own sweep prunes it.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_CLEANUP_SCRATCHPAD_ERASE_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: How long, in hours, nothing must have been written in the scratchpad of an ended session before it is erased rather than moved to the Trash.
